description: Context rules for chat, messaging, community, and social apps with user-generated content or account identity.

effect.appProfileImpact: Chat/social apps often store user identity, messages, contacts, media references, or session state. An unguarded exported provider is a blocker until data exposure is ruled out.
Deep links in chat/social apps can route to profiles, messages, invites, groups, or shared content. Validate parameters and authorization before release.
Messaging, notification, invite, sync, and share surfaces are common in chat/social apps, but exported unguarded services or receivers need a narrow caller contract.
Chat/social apps may store profile state, message cache, contact metadata, media references, or tokens. Backup/data extraction needs explicit scoping before release.
Analytics, ads, crash, and social SDKs are common in chat/social apps, but consent, disclosures, and data-safety declarations still need review.
